title: Explode
wikitext:
'''Explode''' effects cause a killed monster or [[corpse]] to release an [[area of effect]] explosion, dealing [[secondary damage]] to nearby enemies, based on the monster's maximum [[life]]. ==Mechanics== Explosions deal [[secondary damage]], usually based on the maximum life of a [[corpse]] or killed monster, ignoring life modifiers from [[partying]], [[Delve]] depth, and atlas keystones like [[Wellspring of Creation]].https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/un884s/wellspring_of_creation_and_corpse_life/i89khol/?context=1 Their [[hit]]s can be modified by global offensive stats (e.g. added damage, [[conversion]], damage multipliers, [[critical strike]]s, [[area of effect]], on-hit effects such as [[ailments]] and other [[debuffs]]), as long as those stats are ''not'' specific for [[attack]]s or [[spell]]s. Non-skill explosions do not receive stats from the skill that killed the enemy. Non-skill explosions have a base critical strike chance of 0%. They may gain a chance to crit from flat additions such as {{c|mod|+#% to Critical Strike Chance while affected by Hatred}} from a {{il|Watcher's Eye}}. [[Skill]] explosions use the skill's (non-weapon) critical strike chance, such as {{il|Detonate Dead}}'s base 6%. Multiple stats that provide a chance to cause the ''same'' explosion (i.e. damage type, damage percentage, and visual effect) will stack their chance additively (e.g. {{psl|Profane Bloom}} and {{il|Obliteration}} will grant a 70% chance for a 25% life chaos explosion when the player kills a [[curse]]d enemy).https://www.reddit.com/r/pathofexile/comments/cjibec/does_obliterations_enemies_you_kill_have_a_20/evhvgs7/?context=3 ''Different'' types of explosions are rolled independently, and can explode the same enemy at the same time.https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/3123794 Explosions may cause further explosions if the conditions are met, such as a {{il|Herald of Ice}} explosion that freezes and kills another enemy. Enemies that explode on kill do not leave [[corpse]]s. Exploding an existing corpse consumes it. Exploding enemy monsters on death can prevent some on-death effects, such as [[porcupine]] spikes and cold damage over time from spiders in [[Delve]]. It does not prevent on-death effects more separate from the monster, like volatiles from the {{Ml|MapUberModVolatiles}} [[map modifier]], the {{Ml|MonsterArchnemesisLivingCrystals__}} [[monster modifier]], or [[tarred ground]] left by some zombie enemies. Damage from explosions cannot be [[reflect]]ed. While not explosions, comparable effects exist in {{il|Herald of Ash}} and {{il|Legacy of Fury}}, which inflict on-kill [[damage over time]] on nearby enemies, and {{il|Great Old One's Tentacles}} and {{il|Double Strike of Impaling}}, which cause [[impale]] debuffs on killed enemies to reflect damage in an area. ==Gems== ===Skill gems=== {{Query stat related skill gems |type=active |where = skill.stat_text LIKE "%explo%life%" AND items.name NOT LIKE "Somatic%Shell" OR items.name LIKE "%Herald%of%Ice%" }} ===Support gems=== {{Query stat related skill gems |type=support |where = skill.stat_text LIKE "%explo%life%" }} ==Items== ===Base items=== {{Drop enabled base item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where= (item_stats.id LIKE "%Explode%\%%" OR items.description LIKE "%Explode%") AND items.class_id NOT LIKE "Microtransaction" |large=1 |stat=1 |level=1 |description=1 }} ===Unique items=== {{Drop enabled unique item table |tables=item_stats |join=items._pageID=item_stats._pageID |where= items.stat_text LIKE "%Explode%" OR items.name="Megalomaniac" OR items.name="Bubonic Trail" OR items.name="Maw of Mischief" OR items.name = "Cane of Kulemak" |large=1 |base_item=1 |level=1 |stat=1 }} ====Foulborn Unique items==== {| class="wikitable sortable" |- !
